items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: being the teacher’s pet that I was in the first grade, I was helping my teacher clean out her closet... I said Mrs. Ferrell, you’ve got a record.”

ctx.x: No he did not. He said to ask you.

Oh. Well being the teacher’s pet that I was in the first grade, I was helping my teacher clean out her closet and I found some recordings. It was about 1947, ’46. And as far as I knew, records were the blues and Louis Jordan and all that sort of thing. And I knew that white people didn’t listen to that kind of music. So I saw this record, these records, I said Mrs. Ferrell, you’ve got a record.” She said, “Yes.” She said, “You like records?” I couldn’t believe she, you know, was listening to the same thing my…
Your image of Madame Butterfly just changed quite a bit.
